name: Elevator Hitch
source:
Elevator Hitch is a short 2.5D surreal horror/escape room visual novel with point-and-click and puzzle elements following the story of two co-workers suddenly finding themselves stuck together in a "Perfectly Normal" 70s office elevator. 

They must explore each liminal-looking floor and find a way to get off the elevator to their actual destinations.

[From [url=https://racheldrawsthis.itch.io/elevator-hitch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Elevator Hitch》是一款短篇2.5D超现实恐怖密室逃脱视觉小说，融合了点选操作与谜题元素。故事讲述两位同事突然发现自己被困在一部“完全正常”的70年代办公电梯里。

他们必须探索每一层看起来都像阈限空间的楼层，并设法离开电梯，前往各自真正的目的地。

[来源：[url=https://racheldrawsthis.itch.io/elevator-hitch]itch.io[/url]]
